newsitem.title: USA: Imetal unit to buy 2 steel tubing makers.
newsitem.headline: Imetal unit to buy 2 steel tubing makers.

text.p: Copperweld Corp said Monday it reached an agreement to acquire two of Canada's leading steel tubing manufacturers and a U.S. business that sells and distributes certain of their products in the U.S.

To be acquired are Sonco Steel Tube and Standard Tube Canada Inc, operating companies of Toronto-based Ferrum Inc, and the assets of The Tube & Steel Division of The Titan Industrial Corp, headquartered in New York City.

Ferrum is owned jointly by Dofasco Inc, Canada's second largest steel company, and Jannock Ltd, a major Canadian manufacturer and distributor of building products for North American construction markets, Copperweld said.
Copperweld is wholly owned by IMETAL, based in Paris, France.
The combined sales of Sonco, Standard Tube and Titan's tube and steel business are about US$300 million. Copperweld's annual revenues are about US$425 million.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
